components.name: Primary button
components.description: Explicit task action; secondary is the shared Button default.
components.css: .ds-button-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:10px 16px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:12px;background:var(--primary,#181818);color:var(--primary-foreground,#fff);font:500 .875rem/1.7 var(--font-sans,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Noto Sans KR",sans-serif);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 180ms ease,color 180ms ease,transform 180ms ease}.ds-button-primary:hover{background:var(--brand,#49144f)}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring,#49144f);outline-offset:4px}.ds-button-primary:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-button-primary:disabled{background:var(--surface-muted,#efebf0);color:#7c727f;pointer-events:none}

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Explicit task action; secondary is the shared Button default.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:8px 16px;border:1px solid var(--line,#d2ccd4);border-radius:12px;background:var(--secondary,#f4f1f5);color:var(--text,#181818);font:500 .875rem/1.7 var(--font-sans,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Noto Sans KR",sans-serif);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 180ms ease,color 180ms ease,transform 180ms ease}.ds-button-secondary:hover{background:var(--accent,#f6e1ef)}.ds-button-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring,#49144f);outline-offset:4px}.ds-button-secondary:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-button-secondary:disabled{background:var(--surface-muted,#efebf0);color:#7c727f;pointer-events:none}

components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-search">자료 검색</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-search" placeholder="제목이나 내용을 입력하세요">
components.css: .ds-label{display:block;margin-bottom:8px;color:var(--text,#181818);font:500 .875rem/1.7 var(--font-sans,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Noto Sans KR",sans-serif)}.ds-input{width:100%;min-height:44px;padding:8px 20px;border:1px solid var(--input,#86798a);border-radius:12px;background:var(--field-background,#faf9fb);color:var(--text,#181818);font:.875rem/1.7 var(--font-sans,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Noto Sans KR",sans-serif);caret-color:var(--brand,#49144f)}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#655d68)}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring,#49144f);outline-offset:4px}.ds-input:focus-visible{border-color:var(--ring,#49144f);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--ring,#49144f) 50%,transparent)}.ds-input[aria-invalid="true"]{border-color:var(--error,#b42342)}.ds-input:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}

components.name: Workspace tabs
components.description: Four-category visual specimen. Live WorkspaceTabs uses Radix automatic keyboard activation and tab/panel semantics; Reviews persists selection in the URL.

narrative.overview:
A light gray workspace makes saved material, questions, practice and references easy to open. White reusable surfaces organize tasks; plum identifies the learning focus, pink adds context, and black carries decisive actions. The original Code Trainer system sans supports Korean headings, interface labels and sustained reading.

This records the implemented replacement world from source, following the user-pinned brief in PRODUCT.md and the surface direction contract. It does not claim image-comp approval or pixel reproduction. The rejected serif, ink and gold system is superseded. The source authority is `frontend/src/shadcn.css` for the shared light palette, `typography.css` for fonts and shared type roles, and `learning.css` for the final workspace treatment; `main.tsx` loads shadcn, base styles and learning styles in that order.
keyCharacteristics: Explicit labeled task menus and reusable icon-led action cards.
Gray ground, white work surfaces, plum focus and restrained pink accents.
Rounded controls with visible boundaries and keyboard focus.
Mobile reading and question capture; a dark editor for detailed code work.

rules.name: The Action and Context Rule
rules.body: Black marks the primary action or top-level destination; plum and pale pink identify learning context. Preserve labels and `aria-current` or written status alongside color.

rules.name: The Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: Introductory and shared reading copy stop at (72ch); lesson articles and reference chapters use (74ch). Keep long content readable inside the task-oriented shell.

rules.name: The Restrained Gradient Rule
rules.body: Keep gradients limited to the resume surface and empty-state icon wells. Empty icons blend pale pink context into surface-muted (`linear-gradient(145deg, var(--accent), var(--surface-muted))`); recurring work surfaces remain white.

rules.name: The Floating Layer Rule
rules.body: Keep recurring work cards tonal and flat; use the recorded shadows for the menu, dock and question panel.

dos: Do reuse the shared headings, action cards, activity items, empty states and controls.
Do expose problem books and practice as visible Materials destinations.
Do retain task actions, labels, focus and safe-area space when layouts collapse.
Do distinguish saved user writing, source evidence and AI explanation.
donts: Don't restore the rejected serif, gold palette or paragraph-link directory as the main workspace.
Don't turn the primary learning screens into statistics dashboards or management tables.
Don't use decorative eyebrows, repeated labels or hover-only task discovery.
Don't extend component-preview or fixture-render evidence into real-device, paid-AI or whole-product approval.
